verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is not a fair axis for this kind of product. The evidence shows only tuning profiles in the Ryzen Master utility, which store CPU and memory settings. Those are not automations, and nothing shows version history or rollback, so the axis does not become applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
